summary: Review-slot state can reopen duplicate audit work after a reviewer releases its lease while the lane remains REVIEW for an unrelated integration blocker. During this worker's post-task scheduler pass, HG-BACKFILL-AUTHORITY exposed an unclaimed audit slot even though PR #348 exact head aa60103d... already had independent source PASS review 4904866258; HG-BACKFILL-DIAGNOSTICS-INSTANCE-BINDING likewise had no live audit claim while PR #349 exact head 901c063f... already had independent source approval 4904881072. Workers should inspect exact-head PR review history before claiming nominal REVIEW slots; control-plane follow-up should consider a durable review-complete marker/state distinct from integration readiness so released review leases do not invite redundant audits.
evidence: PR #348 exact-head review 4904866258 was already present when the nominal audit slot appeared unclaimed; this worker released claim/resource without duplicating review.
PR #349 exact-head review 4904881072 was already present while its lane remained REVIEW and its audit claim directory was absent.
Both product lanes remain held from integration by the separate trusted-history/pr-ownership recovery rather than by missing source review.
